plat.hero.h1: Six modules. One system. No integration.
plat.hero.sub: Most companies do not have a software problem - they have a stitching problem. Nexyss removes the stitching: the modules do not exchange data with one another, they share the same data.
plat.name: The Platform
plat.cam.h2:
What the modules have in common
is the product.
plat.cam.sub: Exchanging data between systems is integration. Being born from the same data is something else. Four layers that every module inherits the day it is activated - no configuration, no project, no vendor in the middle.
plat.cam.c1.t: A customer is a single record
plat.cam.c1.d: There is no synchronisation because there is no second copy. What Finance sees is literally the same record that CRM edits.
plat.cam.c2.d: Nobody manages access in six places. Joining, leaving and changing role happen once and apply across the whole platform.
plat.cam.c3.d: Who sees what, by unit, region and country. It applies in every module, including those you activate later.
plat.cam.c4.d: Nexyss AI does not receive a slice through an integration. It reads everything the organisation records, in every module, all the time.
plat.mod.h2:
Each module solves on its own.
Together, they solve what none can alone.
plat.mod.sub: You can start with one. What changes when the second one arrives is not the number of features - it is that it already knows everything the first one recorded.
plat.modulos.p1: Pipeline, 360º accounts and continuous forecasting for commercial teams operating across several units and markets.
plat.modulos.div2: Closes a deal and Finance already bills it.

plat.modulos.div10: Hires and access already exists on day one.

plat.flx.h2:
A student enrols.
See what happens without anyone lifting a finger.
plat.flx.sub: In an assembled stack, this event becomes four manual tasks and three reconciliation spreadsheets. Here it is a single event, propagated.
plat.fluxo.div5: Place filled, class updated and student timetable generated
plat.fluxo.div7: Tuition fee created in EUR, with a payment plan and collection scheduled
plat.fluxo.div9: Institution account updated and deal moved to won
plat.fluxo.div11: Revenue forecast and dropout risk recalculated instantly
plat.flx.geral: It applies to any event: a closed contract (CRM → Finance → HR), a new employee (HR → all), a qualified lead (Marketing → CRM). The pattern is the same, the platform is the same.
plat.flx.nota: Illustrative example of the unified platform under construction. Individual module flows available today through consulting and custom integrations.
plat.ia.h2: The advantage of an AI that sees the entire operation.
plat.ia.sub: An AI that only reads the CRM predicts sales. An AI that reads CRM, Finance, Marketing, HR and Education predicts the business. The difference is not in the model - it is in what it can see.
plat.ia.p1: Predictive analytics, KPIs and signal detection across all modules
plat.ia.p2: Conversational assistants for every team, with the context of the whole operation
plat.int.h2:
What is a Nexyss module needs
no connector at all.
plat.int.sub: Integration stops being the glue between your areas and becomes just the bridge to whatever sits outside. It is far less surface to maintain.
plat.int.note: The features below are on the roadmap. Founding Customers take part in defining the delivery order.
plat.int.i1.d: Activating a new module does not open an integration project. It already sees everything the platform has recorded so far.
plat.int.i2.d: Email, calendar, telephony, e-signature, ERPs and payment gateways, ready to plug in.
plat.int.i3.d: Documented REST, real-time events and a test environment for whatever your team needs to build on top.
plat.int.i4.d: Nexyss Consulting leads the migration of the systems the platform will replace, with a cut-over and coexistence plan.
plat.ado.h2:
You do not need to replace everything
on day one.
plat.ado.sub: The platform does not require full adoption to deliver value. It only requires that, when you decide to grow, nothing has to be redone.
plat.ado.c1.d: Solve the most urgent pain in weeks, not quarters. Without compromising the rest of the operation.
plat.ado.c2.d: No migration and no integration project: the data it needs is already on the platform.
plat.ado.c3.d: When the sixth module comes in, nothing has to be redone. The entire operation starts speaking the same language.
plat.vs.h2:
The same result,
two very different paths.
plat.vs.sub: It is not about having more features. It is about where your team's effort ends up every month.

crm.prob.h2:
Your CRM is not wrong.
It is just on its own.
crm.prob.sub: Most commercial teams run on a CRM that does not talk to finance, cannot see marketing and does not know what support promised. The result is not a lack of data - it is an excess of versions of it.
crm.prob.c1.t: The truth lives in three places
crm.prob.c1.d: The contract value is in the CRM, the invoice is in the ERP and the promise is in an email. Nobody knows which of the three is right - and every meeting starts by reconciling a spreadsheet.
crm.prob.c2.t: The forecast is born out of date
crm.prob.c2.d: The spreadsheet put together on Monday is no longer valid on Wednesday. But the board decides with Monday's number, because it is the only one that exists.
crm.prob.c3.t: Every unit starts again from zero
crm.prob.c3.d: New branch, new process, new custom fields, new currency. Consolidating stops being a report and becomes a project with a deadline and a budget.

Everything a commercial team does -
in a single system.
crm.rec.sub: It is not a CRM with integrations. It is a CRM born inside the same database as your organisation's finance, marketing, HR and education.

edu.prob.h2:
Your network has grown.
Your systems have not grown with it.
edu.prob.sub: Each campus solved its own problem with its own tool. Today the network operator has eight closing spreadsheets, three definitions of “active student” and no quick answer when the board asks how the network is doing.
edu.prob.c1.t: The student's history lives in pieces
edu.prob.c1.d: The registrar's office has the academic record, finance has the tuition fee, coordination has attendance. Reconstructing a student's journey has become archaeology.
edu.prob.c2.d: Same institution, different processes, different calendars, reports that do not add up. Consolidating the network becomes an end-of-semester project.
edu.prob.c3.d: By the time the student stops paying or disappears from class, the signal had existed for months - scattered across systems that do not talk to each other.
edu.rec.h2:
An institution does a great many things.

mkt.prob.h2:
Your marketing is not wrong.
It just cannot see the end of the story.
mkt.prob.sub: Most marketing teams run on tools that talk to neither sales nor finance. The result is not a lack of campaigns - it is a lack of a calculation that closes.
mkt.prob.c1.t: The lead changes hands and loses its memory
mkt.prob.c1.d: Every form becomes a file, every file becomes a spreadsheet. By the time the contact reaches the salesperson, the context of everything they have read and clicked has been left behind.
mkt.prob.c2.t: Marketing measures clicks, the company measures revenue
mkt.prob.c2.d: The campaign report ends where the contract begins. Nobody closes the books between what was invested and what came back - and next quarter's budget becomes opinion.
mkt.prob.c3.d: Email in one place, ads in another, pages in a third. Three dashboards, three definitions of “qualified lead” and no single view of the contact.

sobre.ori.h2: Before it was a platform, it was an operation.
sobre.ori.p1: We spent more than ten years inside a real education operation. In that time, every new tool promised to solve one problem and created two: one more tab, one more login, one more spreadsheet to stitch together what the systems did not connect.
sobre.ori.p2: We learned what really weighs: data that is born in one place and dies in another, the team that becomes the integrator, the report nobody can close.
sobre.ori.p3: The market sells shiny apps, one for each pain, and the result is a pile of systems that your team has to keep connected to one another. Nexyss does the opposite: modules born in the same record, so that nobody has to stitch.
sobre.ori.quote: We rolled up our sleeves before writing the first line of code. That is why Nexyss solves what the operation asks for, not what the software finds pretty.
sobre.conf.h2: Three reasons, with no promise of results.
sobre.conf.sub: We do not promise a number. We show how we work and let you check.
sobre.conf.c1.d: Every module comes from a problem lived from the inside. We do not design screens before understanding the routine.
sobre.conf.c2.d: The modules share the same data, the same identity and the same permission. When one changes, the others see it.
sobre.conf.c3.t: We say what exists and what does not
sobre.conf.c3.d: Every page shows the status of each feature: Active, Beta or Roadmap. If it does not exist yet, it says so.

sobre.faq.q2: Can I start with one module?
sobre.faq.a2: Yes. The platform does not require full adoption: you start with the module for your most urgent pain and add the others when it makes sense.
